eval: (async()=>{for(const m of app.plugins.plugins['journey-import'].modals)m.close();const p=app.plugins.plugins['journey-import'];const f=app.vault.getFileByPath('Journey Diary Import/journey-fixture.zip');const bytes=new Uint8Array(await app.vault.readBinary(f));p.pro.signOut();const old=app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Journey Diary Import/Imported');if(old)await app.vault.delete(old,true);await p.importArchive(p.parseZip(bytes),{folder:'Journey Diary Import/Imported',attachments:'Journey Diary Import/Imported/attachments',merge:false,group:false,pattern:'{date} {time}'});await app.workspace.openLinkText('Journey Diary Import/Imported/2021-07-01 1200.md','',false);await app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:'Journey Diary Import/Imported/2021-07-01 1200.md',mode:'preview'}});return 'ok';})()

caption: The imported photo is a local vault attachment.
